title: SMProfile-SegmentRequirement payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/segment-requirement.json 4.0.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

segment_requirement_no.description: Identity of the SegmentRequirement (join key): its number within its production order, <production_order_no>.<operation number> — as the source system keys an operation (order + operation number; OPEN-0350 round 4).

production_order_ref.description: FK to ProductionOrder.production_order_no (PART_OF). The OperationsRequest to which this segment target belongs.

process_segment_ref.description: FK to ProcessSegment.process_segment_no (FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT). Which manufacturing stage (= plant = Function) is planned here.

sequence.description: Sequence of this segment within the order.

material_ref.description: FK to Article.article_no (REQUIRES_MATERIAL) = MaterialRequirement.MaterialDefinitionID. The target material of this stage.

material_use.description: ISA-95 MaterialRequirement.MaterialUse — the ROLE of the material in this stage. Encodes the 'Being Consumed/Produced/Tested/Moved'.

qty_planned.description: Planned quantity of this material role (target). Counterpart to SegmentResponse.qty_actual.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure of qty_planned (UN/CEFACT code recommended).

equipment_ref.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ Unit level) = EquipmentRequirement.EquipmentID. The target equipment of the stage.

operations_definition_ref.description: The OperationsDefinition (FOR_OPERATIONS_DEFINITION; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → OperationsDefinition). Optional.

operations_definition_version.description: The version of the operations definition this order / response ran with, where the source's definition id carries none (a routing number with its own change state). Empty when the id itself names the version.

operations_segment_ref.description: The OperationsSegment (FOR_OPERATIONS_SEGMENT; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → OperationsSegment). Optional.

parent_segment_requirement_ref.description: The SegmentRequirement this SegmentRequirement is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement MADE_UP_OF SegmentRequirement). Optional.

segment_response_ref.description: The SegmentResponse (REQUESTS_SEGMENT_RESPONSE; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → SegmentResponse). Optional.

equipment_class_ref.description: The EquipmentClass (REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → EquipmentClass). Optional.

material_class_ref.description: The MaterialClass (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → MaterialClass). Optional.

material_lot_ref.description: The MaterialLot (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → MaterialLot). Optional.

quant_ref.description: The Quant (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

person_ref.description: The Person (REQUIRES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → Person). Optional.

personnel_class_ref.description: The PersonnelClass (REQUIRES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → PersonnelClass). Optional.

tool_ref.description: The Tool (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → PhysicalAsset). Optional.

physical_asset_class_ref.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

test_specification_ref.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 SegmentRequirement → TestSpecification). Optional.

operations_type.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).
